title: YEA SaaS explorer data: what you can drop, what you keep

risk_scale.none: Nothing at stake. Swap it this week.
risk_scale.low: Data moves cleanly. Small rebuild, no money or compliance attached.
risk_scale.mid: Live revenue, contracts, consent records or history the business runs on. Needs a migration plan and a parallel run.
risk_scale.high: Money, compliance, deliverability, or data you cannot lose. Move last with a full parallel run, or keep it.

modules_note: YEA module names are provisional until PSAI-21 (module map) lands.

products.name: QuickBooks Online

price.basis: monthly list price ($19 promo for 3 months)

products.risk_why: The books are the record your CPA, lender and the IRS rely on. Bank feeds, reconciliations and tax categories cannot break. Move last, run both in parallel through a full close.

products.name: Xero
products.risk_why: Same as QuickBooks. Money and tax records, parallel run through a close.

products.name: FreshBooks
products.risk_why: Open invoices, client payment history and tax records. A missed invoice is missed cash.

products.name: Wave
products.risk_why: Still the books. Same rules as QuickBooks.

products.name: Google Workspace (Gmail)

price.basis: per user, annual ($3.50 promo for new customers)

products.risk_why: Your domain email is your identity, your login recovery and your sender reputation. MX records, years of mail, calendar invites and every vendor password reset ride on it. Move last, or keep it.
